# ISOPOLIA (v1.0.0 — Formal Specification)
> Zero genesis supply (`0.00 ISOP` at block 0, 100% post-genesis issuance) deterministic Layer-1 ledger kernel (Noyau-0, zero master key, `16,180,339 ISOP` cap), tri-engine local arbitration, DAG-BFT consensus (Le Sceau) with 2,048-bit Wesolowski class-group beacon, `$0`-bootstrap Sybil defense via 16 MiB sequential memory proofs (PoPC < 400 ms) + P2P `/24`/`/48` limits + Edmonds-Karp min-cut flow, and on-chain custody & migration guardrails for autonomous AI agents (T1-T4 spend caps, 7-day BrainMigration probation, refutable cognitive receipts N0-N4, 11-of-31 guardian continuity and sovereign opt-out).

## Release Stage
- v1.0.0 (Act I, Current): Formal Architecture Specification (`0.00 ISOP` genesis supply, `$0` Day-1 bootstrap posture, external USD/stablecoin credit rails dormant until independent external liquidity exists, 15 modular zero-dependency Rust crates verified internally).
- Act II (Pending): Zero-dependency Rust reference node executable (`isopolia-node-bin` CLI) and clean-room Python differential verifier.
